newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-PARNEVIK OVERTAKES CLARKE, WOODS SHOOTS 64.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PARNEVIK OVERTAKES CLARKE, WOODS SHOOTS 64.

text.p: Jesper Parnevik, seeking to atone for thowing away the 1994 title, overhauled Darren Clarke with a five-under-par third round 66 on Saturday to head the British Open by two shots.

The 32-year-old U.S.-based Swede fired a two-under-par 33 on the back nine to take advantage of slack play from the Northern Irishman and turned a four-shot deficit with nine holes left into a two-stroke lead.
Parnevik was beaten by Nick Price by one shot in the 1994 Open at Turnberry when he bogeyed the last hole.
Clarke, the joint first round leader and three ahead overnight, slid to a 39 on the back nine with four bogeys and not a single birdie in a level-par 71.
Americans Fred Couples and Justin Leonard stood five shots off the lead, Couples after a one-under-par 70 comprising 16 pars, an eagle two with a 168-yard six-iron shot at the 11th and a bogey at 17.
Leonard shot 72 with 15 pars, two bogeys and a birdie at 17.
World number one Woods, the Masters champion, shot a 64 which matched the record round for British Opens at Royal Troon.
That left the 21-year-old American phenomenon joint eighth eight shots off the lead and needing a miracle to win the title on Sunday.
